description: Governed inventory of every --_ds-proto-* prototoken. A prototoken is a PRIVATE candidate axis: a hook a family opens so a future authority can be adjudicated over it. It is never a public contract and never reaches a generated tenant artifact. It may remain embedded inside a shipped skin bundle only while its source and every consumer are governed by an active ledger row. Enforced by scripts/prototype-ledger-gate.mjs; there is no baseline.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-affix-affixed-keyline
entries.purpose: Keyline under an affixed element.
entries.fallback: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-color-border-secondary) calc(55% * var(--ds-effect-intensity)), transparent)
entries.notes: Exemplar: a declared dial multiplied by --ds-effect-intensity.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-autocomplete-dropdown-max-width
entries.purpose: Maximum dropdown width.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-autocomplete-option-height
entries.purpose: Minimum option height, scaled by density.
entries.notes: MIGRATION PENDING: autocomplete.css is owned by another lane this wave. Target: --ds-input-md-height.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-breadcrumb-link-underline-color
entries.purpose: Underline tint of a breadcrumb link.
entries.notes: The one color with no channel, legitimately: it derives from currentColor, so it follows the text it belongs to.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-callout-tone-ink
entries.purpose: Ink for callout copy over the tone fill, per data-tone.
entries.notes: AUT-1 seed: its AA-measured mixes are the values --ds-color-on-{tone} was derived from. Definition stays local until the authority absorbs it.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-codeblock-language-badge-bg
entries.purpose: Chip tint behind the bare language tag in the header.
entries.notes: Now consumed from code-block.css instead of a branch inside a TSX style object; the badge is a MODE of the title part, keyed on data-language-badge. Values preserved byte-for-byte.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-codeblock-scroll-shadow
entries.purpose: Gradient scroll-edge affordance of the code region.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-confirm-dialog-icon-size
entries.purpose: Medallion track of the dialog feature icon.
entries.notes: derived-to: --ds-icon-size-feature (C1, 2.5rem). Zero pixel change.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-context-menu-icon-well
entries.purpose: Square well that optically aligns row glyphs.
entries.notes: derived-to: --ds-icon-size-well (C1, 1.25rem). Zero pixel change.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-datepicker-cell-size
entries.purpose: Calendar cell box, scaled by density.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-datepicker-grid-gap

entries.name: --_ds-proto-datepicker-range-band-bg

entries.name: --_ds-proto-datepicker-range-preview-bg
entries.purpose: Band fill behind cells in the hover-preview range.
entries.notes: derived-to: --ds-wash-band-preview (C1). Fallback preserved as the parse floor; zero pixel change.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-datepicker-today-marker-bg
entries.purpose: Fill of the today dot in the calendar grid.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-datepicker-today-marker-size

entries.name: --_ds-proto-dropdown-arrow-anchor-offset

entries.notes: Coupled to the TSX through [data-arrow-tracked] under the SAME condition on both sides: fragile but correct, and documented as such.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-dropdown-item-height-current
entries.purpose: Resolved item height for the current density.
entries.notes: Exemplar of the "-current" resolved-axis idiom.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-dropdown-item-padding-block-current

entries.name: --_ds-proto-dropdown-item-padding-inline-current

entries.name: --_ds-proto-dropdown-menu-max-block-size

entries.name: --_ds-proto-float-button-panel-closed-offset

entries.name: --_ds-proto-form-control-height
entries.purpose: Resolved control height for the current data-size.
entries.notes: Exact twin of form-field-control-height. Unification is blocked on the Form/FormField family adjudication (DEC-05), not on this ledger.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-form-error-icon-size

entries.notes: MERGED into the status role with form-field: the 13px vs 14px split for the SAME glyph was the bug. derived-to: --ds-icon-size-status. REGISTERED DELTA: 13px -> 14px.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-form-field-label-color-focus
entries.purpose: Label ink while the field is focus-within.
entries.notes: Already chains to a declared channel; nothing to derive.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-icon-frame-glass-bg

entries.notes: Chains the governed alpha-white channel; a governed glass recipe, not a loose literal.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-icon-frame-size
entries.purpose: Frame box for the current data-size.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-icon-frame-subtle-strength

entries.notes: Rides the wash ramp once AUT-2 covers strength as well as color.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-kbd-pressed-shadow
entries.purpose: Inset highlight of a pressed key cap.
entries.notes: Assumes a light source; folds into the future elevation grammar (EE-02).

entries.name: --_ds-proto-link-current-font-weight

entries.notes: derived-to: --ds-font-weight-medium (500). Zero pixel change.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-list-split-inset-inline

entries.name: --_ds-proto-markdown-task-fill

entries.notes: Exemplar: a proto defined solely inside a media guard, consumed from the TSX.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-markdown-task-fill-ring

entries.name: --_ds-proto-mentions-option-active-border

entries.notes: Owner exception to the matrix DERIVE: 28% primary over transparent is an edge tint, not the selection wash.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-mentions-trigger-accent
entries.purpose: Accent edge of the mentions trigger.
entries.notes: Owner exception to the matrix DERIVE: mixes primary INTO --ds-color-border-subtle, so it is not a pure wash over transparent.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-menu-horizontal-block-size

entries.notes: derived-to: --ds-spacing-11 (2.75rem = 44px at density 1). Zero pixel change at default density; the row now tracks --ds-density-effective-scale like every sibling axis in this file, which the 44px literal did not.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-meter-ring-size
entries.purpose: Ring diameter for the current data-size.
entries.notes: Feeds the shared arc substrate via --_ds-arc-size.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-meter-track-bg
entries.purpose: Unfilled track fill of a meter.
entries.notes: Its documented "envy" of --ds-progress-bg is the symptom of the missing arc substrate, not of a missing token.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-meter-track-size
entries.purpose: Track thickness for the current data-size.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-modal-density-compact-section-padding-block
entries.purpose: Section block padding under the compact density.
entries.notes: Density travels through the existing densityProfile and spacing x density; four public knobs per family is the sprawl the material law forbids.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-modal-density-compact-section-padding-inline
entries.purpose: Section inline padding under the compact density.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-modal-density-spacious-section-padding-block
entries.purpose: Section block padding under the spacious density.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-otp-filled-keyline
entries.purpose: Underline of a filled OTP slot.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-pagination-jumper-width
entries.purpose: Width of the quick-jumper input.
entries.notes: Arrived mid-wave from a concurrent lane; carries no row in the phase-C matrix. Classified PRIVATE as local control geometry with no existing width channel.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-pagination-size-arrow-clearance

entries.notes: DELIBERATELY NOT MIGRATED this wave. debt: select-native-arrow substrate. Its fallback borrows --ds-select-native-arrow-clearance ACROSS families; the fix is a shared native-arrow substrate, not a rewire of this one site.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-pagination-size-arrow-inset
entries.purpose: Inline inset of the size-select arrow.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-password-strength-gap
entries.purpose: Gap between strength-meter segments.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-password-strength-label-color
entries.purpose: Ink of the strength-meter caption.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-popover-opaque-surface
entries.purpose: Opaque panel fill substituted under prefers-reduced-transparency.
entries.notes: AUT-3. derived-to: --ds-material-overlay-opaque, inserted BELOW --ds-popover-bg: the family channel is a declared solid a tenant owns, so the authority replaces only the ad-hoc surface pick that used to close the chain.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-select-success-bg
entries.purpose: Field fill in the success validation state.
entries.notes: MIGRATION PENDING: select.css is owned by another lane this wave. Debt: the error/warning peers have no rows at all.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-semanticsurface-nest-inset
entries.purpose: Amount subtracted from the parent radius for a nested surface.
entries.notes: AUT-5. derived-to: --ds-radius-nest-inset (C1, 4px). Zero pixel change. The formula stays local; only the inset is the authority.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-slider-tooltip-gap
entries.purpose: Gap between the thumb and its value tooltip.
entries.notes: Repeated across six placement rules; should be defined once at the family root.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-spinner-label-measure
entries.purpose: Maximum line measure of the spinner caption.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-stack-divider-gap-block

entries.notes: The only fallback chaining to another PRIVATE name (--_ds-stack-gap-current); correct, both are plumbing.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-stack-divider-gap-inline
entries.purpose: Inline bleed of a Stack divider.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-stepper-connector-clearance
entries.purpose: Gap between a step marker and its connector.
entries.notes: Byte-identical to the steps peer modulo three substitutions; family debt tracked under DEC-05.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-steps-connector-clearance
entries.purpose: Gap between a step marker and its connector.
entries.notes: Byte-identical to the stepper peer modulo three substitutions; family debt tracked under DEC-05.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-table-utility-column-width
entries.purpose: Width of selection/action utility columns, scaled by density.
entries.notes: Recipe candidate only if Table asks for it.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tabs-scroll-pad
entries.purpose: Scroll padding of the tab track.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tag-input-rejected-color
entries.purpose: Ink for a tag rejected by the input validator.
entries.notes: Fallback is byte-identical to the callout warning ink. MIGRATION PENDING: target --ds-color-warning-ink is not emitted yet (C1 shipped --ds-color-on-warning, the ink-over-surface channel is a later authority).

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tag-root-height
entries.purpose: Resolved tag height for the current data-size.
entries.notes: derived-to: --ds-tag-md-height at the CONSUMPTION site (the close-well cap). The per-size definitions already chain to their own channels. Zero pixel change.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-textarea-resize-grip-ink
entries.purpose: Ink of the resize-grip glyph at rest.
entries.notes: NO ROW in the phase-C matrix: the census counted 79 names but the tables enumerate 76. Classified PRIVATE as local affordance paint.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-textarea-resize-grip-ink-hover
entries.purpose: Ink of the resize-grip glyph on hover.
entries.notes: NO ROW in the phase-C matrix (see the rest-state peer).

entries.name: --_ds-proto-textarea-resize-grip-size
entries.purpose: Tile size of the resize-grip pattern.
entries.notes: NO ROW in the phase-C matrix (see the ink peers).

entries.name: --_ds-proto-timeline-dot-ring-color
entries.purpose: Halo separating a timeline dot from the rail behind it.
entries.notes: Rides the canvas channel: correct by construction, the halo must match whatever sits behind.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-timeline-state-keyline
entries.purpose: Inset keyline around a state-carrying timeline dot.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-toggle-state-icon-size
entries.purpose: State glyph inside the toggle thumb.
entries.notes: Legitimate geometric ratio of the thumb, not a role: it must track the thumb, not the icon scale.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tooltip-opaque-surface
entries.purpose: Opaque bubble fill substituted under prefers-reduced-transparency.
entries.notes: AUT-3. derived-to: --ds-material-overlay-opaque, REPLACING --ds-surface-overlay. That channel is the scrim and a vertical may bind it translucent (bithire: rgba(20,40,59,0.42)), which defeated the guard. Registered delta: SC-7 closed.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-transfer-search-icon-inset
entries.purpose: Inline inset reserving room for the search glyph.
entries.notes: Not a recipe axis: this is the future affix substrate for inputs.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tree-dragging-opacity
entries.purpose: Opacity of a row while it is being dragged.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tree-row-bg-active
entries.purpose: Fill of the active tree row.
entries.notes: Owner exception to the matrix DERIVE: the formula mixes --ds-surface-inset at 75%, not a primary wash, so --ds-wash-active is the wrong authority for it.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tree-row-padding-block
entries.purpose: Row block padding, scaled by density.
entries.notes: INERT until the legacy shorthand above it is unpinned.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-tree-row-padding-inline
entries.purpose: Row inline padding, scaled by density.
entries.notes: INERT until the legacy shorthand above it is unpinned.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-voice-input-error-dot-size
entries.purpose: Error status dot on the mic button.
entries.notes: Shape marker, not an icon.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-meter-ring-value
entries.purpose: Per-instance 0..100 sweep of the meter ring, stamped by the owner TSX.
entries.notes: Retired into the shared arc substrate: the value now travels as --_ds-arc-value, registered exactly once via @property in presentation/components/arc.css and stamped by Meter/index.tsx and progress.css. A per-instance value is a runtime bridge, never a tenant token.

entries.name: --_ds-proto-input-autofill-freeze-duration
entries.purpose: The 9999s duration that froze the browser autofill transition.
entries.notes: Retired with the idiom itself: the 9999s animation-freeze hack is gone from the tree entirely (zero occurrences). The autofilled posture is now painted directly from the public --ds-input-autofill-{bg,color,caret} channels, consumed by input.css, textarea.css and autocomplete.css. No successor proto exists, which is why this is DELETE and not MERGE_RENAME.
